mapper.sql: t.id, t.conversation_id, t.trip_id, t.user_id, t.trigger_message_id, t.reply_message_id, t.status, t.counted, t.locale, t.question, t.steps::text AS steps, t.error, t.input_tokens, t.output_tokens, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.created_at, COALESCE(u.full_name, u.username) AS user_name

p.id, p.conversation_id, p.turn_id, p.message_id, p.trip_id, p.requested_by, p.action, p.payload::text AS payload, p.summary, p.status, p.resolved_by, p.resolved_at, p.result_activity_id, p.failure_reason, p.created_at, COALESCE(u.full_name, u.username) AS resolved_by_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_turns (id, conversation_id, trip_id, user_id, trigger_message_id, status, counted, locale, question, steps, started_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{tripId}, #{userId}, #{triggerMessageId}, #{status}, #{counted}, #{locale}, #{question}, COALESCE(#{steps}, '[]')::jsonb, #{startedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.conversation_id, t.trip_id, t.user_id, t.trigger_message_id, t.reply_message_id, t.status, t.counted, t.locale, t.question, t.steps::text AS steps, t.error, t.input_tokens, t.output_tokens, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.created_at FROM assistant_turns t WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM assistant_turns t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND t.status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY t.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM assistant_turns t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND t.status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assistant_turns WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_turns SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{startedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE assistant_turns SET steps = steps || #{step}::jsonb WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE assistant_turns SET status = 'COMPLETED', reply_message_id = #{replyMessageId}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE assistant_turns SET status = 'FAILED', counted = FALSE, error = #{error}, reply_message_id = #{replyMessageId}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM assistant_turns WHERE (status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{runningBefore}) OR (status = 'QUEUED' AND created_at < #{queuedBefore}) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id, m.sender_user_id AS senderUserId, COALESCE(u.full_name, u.username) AS senderName, m.message_type AS messageType, m.content, m.attachments::text AS attachments, m.sequence_no AS sequenceNo FROM marketplace_messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.sender_user_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.sequence_no < #{beforeSequence} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.message_type IN ('TEXT', 'IMAGE', 'SHARE', 'ASSISTANT') ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id, m.sender_user_id AS senderUserId, COALESCE(u.full_name, u.username) AS senderName, m.message_type AS messageType, m.content, m.attachments::text AS attachments, m.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, m.reply_to_message_id AS replyToMessageId FROM marketplace_messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.sender_user_id WHERE m.id = #{messageId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT sender_user_id FROM marketplace_messages WHERE id = #{messageId}
SELECT sequence_no FROM marketplace_messages WHERE id = #{messageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_proposals (id, conversation_id, turn_id, message_id, trip_id, requested_by, action, payload, summary, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{messageId}, #{tripId}, #{requestedBy}, #{action}, COALESCE(#{payload}, '{}')::jsonb, #{summary}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.conversation_id, p.turn_id, p.message_id, p.trip_id, p.requested_by, p.action, p.payload::text AS payload, p.summary, p.status, p.resolved_by, p.resolved_at, p.result_activity_id, p.failure_reason, p.created_at FROM assistant_proposals p WHERE p.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_proposals SET status = #{status}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, result_activity_id = #{resultActivityId}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, trip_id = COALESCE(#{createdTripId}, trip_id) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM assistant_proposals p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.resolved_by WHERE p.message_id IN #{messageId} AND p.action IN ('NEW_TRIP', 'PLAN_DAYS') ORDER BY p.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_proposals SET message_id = #{messageId} WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} AND message_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM assistant_memories WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_memories (conversation_id, content, turn_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{content}, #{turnId}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, turn_id = EXCLUDED.turn_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM assistant_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_profiles (user_id, content, turn_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{turnId}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, turn_id = EXCLUDED.turn_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
